2) Envelope B (AdobeSign) — EU signers: Velox EU signer, Marissa signs (Sales), Rishi countersigns. AdobeSign will be used to satisfy EU data residency preferences; envelope will be created with EU tenant settings.

- Please confirm the Velox signatory names and titles so we can populate the signatory_matrix.xlsx (attached).
- For compliance: we recommend KBA for US execs and optional ID upload for EU signers; confirm if that works.
- If Velox wants the countersign to occur before the Sales signature, flag that now — legal has different preferences.

I will draft the envelopes once you confirm the signers. I’ll create HubSpot activity and add the DocuSign envelope link to the deal record for visibility.

Best,

Naomi / Marissa — quick legal note after scanning Velox redlines (Velox_DPA_v3_redlines.pdf):

- Routing: legal must countersign before the sales-safe copy is distributed externally. In practice this means Rishi must be last actor inside the envelope (countersign), but the envelope configuration must prevent automatic completion until legal stamps the countersign. If Sales signs first we risk premature execution.
- Subprocessor clause: Velox redlined section 4.2. We need to include the proposed subprocessor notice and a 30-day advance notification for new subprocessors; confirm if Velox is OK with Redwood's standard 14-day notice (we'd prefer that to keep SLA practical).
- Data transfer: ensure the envelope for EU has SCCs referenced; AdobeSign must be configured to EU data region.
- Authentication: require KBA for US signers; for high-risk signees we should enable ID verification (photo ID) via AdobeSign.

Operational asks for envelope creation:
- Set signing order locked (yes/no?) — I recommend locked.
- Set reminder cadence: 48h and 96h.
- Envelope subject line should read: "Velox DPA Countersign — Redwood Inference" to match procurement records.

@Naomi — please prepare two envelopes (DS + Adobe) but do not send until I confirm countersign placement.

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
Lead Counsel, Contracts | Redwood Inference

- DocuSign vs AdobeSign: because of a scheduled platform maintenance next week, we prefer AdobeSign for EU. If Redwood is creating the envelopes, please confirm you can spin Adobe tenant and ensure SCC references.
- Extension request: can we move target countersign date to 2027-06-03 to give procurement a little extra time?

If that works I can have our Finance contact issue a final PO annotated with intended sign order.
